the conductivity of the Li 2 S-P 2 S 2 -LiI glass is 2.3×10 −2 S/cm at 25 °C, and the Li 2 -S-P 2 S -LiI glass has the highest conductivity among the Li 2-S-P 2 S glass electrolytes containing LiX (X=I, BF 3, Tf, and PF6) salt, because of the dissociation of LiX salt in the glass matrix
mechanical milling is a promising method for synthesizing Li 2 S-P 2 S 4 -LiX glasses, and that LiI-incorporated glass exhibits high conductivity.
mechanical synthesis of Li 2 S-P 2 S 4 glasses is a simple and effective method to prepare lithium salt incorporated glassy electrolytes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanochemical synthesis of glass electrolytes in the systems Li2S– P2S5 –LiX, and the effect of various lithium salts on the ionic conductivity of glass electrolytes.
a novel mechanochemical synthesis of sulfide glasses containing various kinds of lithium salts and their conductivity.

the preparation of Li2S-P2S5 glass by mechanical alloying, which is a very simple and cost-effective method, and with the investigation of the influence of different lithium salts on the conductivity of the glass.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Li 2 S-P 2 S 3 glass with LiI is an appropriate electrolyte candidate for all-solid-state Li-ion batteries.
the Li 2 S-P 2 S 4 -LiI glass electrolyte is the best candidate for all solid-state lithium secondary battery.
the mechanical synthesis method is a promising method for the fabrication of sulfide glasses with high lithium salts contents.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the glass electrolyte with high conductivity can be prepared by incorporating LiI in the system of Li 2 S-P 2 S 3.
the conductivity of Li 2 S-P 2 S 2 glass was improved by the addition of LiI.
the conductivity of sulfide glass can be improved by the addition of LiI, but not with other lithium salts.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the glass conductivity is largely dependent on the variety of the lithium salts and the milling conditions.
the conductivity of Li 2 S-P 2 S 4 glasses can be enhanced by incorporating LiX salts (X = I, TFSA and Tf) into glass matrix, and it can be decreased by incorporating LiBF 4 and LiPF 6.
the conductivity of the sulfide-based glass electrolytes can be controlled by incorporating different lithium salts.
